text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up thread 1:01. We need concrete rollout safety changes after yesterday's tenant-impacting flag. I sketched owners + a minimal plan below, please review and ack.
sam: +1. I'll take the auto-rollback work (with simulation mode first). Will draft API + controller prototype.
li: Strong yes on per-flag blast-radius caps. Also propose flag metadata: owner, allowed_regions, max_percentage, max_host_groups.
ryan: I'll handle observability/runbooks. Signals to consider: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m, p95 > 2x baseline for 5m, cross-tenant error concentration metric.
tess: I'll add a synthetic smoke harness that runs against canary at 5% before any further ramp. If smoke fails -> hold and require manual continue or auto-rollback based on policy.
security-team: Kill-switch must be Vault-backed and audited. Suggest role rollout_kill_switch with emergency approval flow.
marta: Draft action items (please confirm):
- sam: auto-rollback controller (simulation + API) by 2026-04-07
- li: blast-radius gating spec + migration plan by 2026-04-05
- ryan: dashboard, alerts, and runbook by 2026-04-09
- tess: synthetic smoke-run harness + test matrix by 2026-04-08
- security-team: vault-based kill-switch model & review by 2026-04-06
sam: Quick API sketch for auto-rollback (simulation mode):
```
POST /rollouts/:id/auto_rollback
{
  "enabled": true,
  "simulation": true,
  "conditions": ["500_rate > 0.5%", "p95 > 2x"],
  "grace_period_s": 180
}
```
li: Blast-radius sample config (per-flag):
```
{
  "owner": "team-foo",
  "max_users": 500,
  "max_hosts": 8,
  "max_percentage": 3,
  "allowed_regions": ["us-east-1","eu-west-1"]
}
```
ryan: Note: during simulation the UI should show "rollback recommended" annotation but not take actions. We'll flip to enforced after a validation window.
tess: Test matrix for smoke-run: login, write-critical-path, read-critical-path, background-job-run. Fail any -> hold.
marta: I'll open umbrella issues and link to the postmortem. Sync scheduled Fri 09:30 to hand off and lock timelines. React :thumbsup: when you accept.
ryan: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup: will add migration caveats for long-lived flags.
tess: :thumbsup:
sam: Will add simulation logs to a separate index so we can query false-positive rates.
security-team: acknowledged. We'll draft the ACL + emergency workflow doc.
deploy-bot: infra/rollout-controller v2.2.0 deploy started
marta: Thanks all. Small note: ensure customer-facing incidents are referenced in the postmortem so SRE can correlate alerts to tenant metrics. End of thread.
